name: $T = \frac{1}{f}$
e: Relation between period and frequency is written $T = \frac{1}{f}$. Frequency counts complete waves per second, and v equals f lambda.

name: $v = f\lambda$
content: Wave equation relating velocity, frequency, and wavelength
e: Wave equation relating velocity, frequency, and wavelength is written $v = f\lambda$. Wavelength is crest to next crest, and v equals f lambda.

name: $v = \frac{d}{t}$
content: Speed of sound / wave velocity formula
e: Speed of sound / wave velocity formula is written $v = \frac{d}{t}$. Velocity is directed. Speed is the size of that velocity.

name: $v = 332\sqrt{\frac{T}{273}}$
content: Speed of sound in air as a function of absolute temperature
e: Speed of sound in air as a function of absolute temperature is written $v = 332\sqrt{\frac{T}{273}}$. Temperature tells you the hotness. Heat tells you energy transferred.

name: $v \cong 332 + 0.6(T - 273)$
content: Approximation formula for the speed of sound in air with temperature
e: Approximation formula for the speed of sound in air with temperature is written $v \cong 332 + 0.6(T - 273)$. Temperature tells you the hotness. Heat tells you energy transferred.
